sloka: क्रेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने ।महागज इन्वारण्ये स्नेहात्परिममर्श ताम् ॥२-१०-२६॥
transliteration: kreṇumiva digdhena viddhāṁ mṛgayunā vane ।mahāgaja invāraṇye snehātparimamarśa tām ॥2-10-26॥

translations.english: Like a mighty sheelephant caressing her cow wounded with a poisoned arrow in the forest, he caressed her lovingly.
